title: Verify checkout cart summary and proceed to shipping
description: Test the complete checkout flow from cart review through shipping address entry
preConditions: User is logged in and has items in the shopping cart

steps.action: Navigate to the checkout page and verify the cart summary is displayed
steps.expectedResult: Cart summary shows all items with correct quantities and prices; subtotal and tax are calculated correctly
User is redirected to the shipping address form with all required fields visible
